interpretation: Fresh-current-source H16encode comparison; allcommon objects reused from234310, onlynative.cpp.o replaced. CPU0 sequentialABBA at256/8192/1048576values. Allcases and orderingedges retained. Preflight timings excluded. See metadata-correction.json for inherited, inapplicable ordinary-reader validation prose.
prior_comparison: Each before/after-prior.csv compares its variant best available Ikea family for each H16layout against the faster retained Calico geometry of the same logical width and input size. These are whole encodings with different representations; Calico h0 naming does not mean no internal planes.

selection_curation.note: Git selection and local navigation changed; measured source, job, and full-bundle identities are unchanged.

units: CPU/real times are ns per benchmark iteration. ns_per_item uses the reported item rate; an item means what the benchmark counts, not necessarily a value or byte.
